title: finding(plugin-detail/fields): a single select or radio emptied by a cascade prune stages `undefined`, which the JSON transport drops on Save — the field the user saw cleared keeps its stored value and reappears on refresh
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat #1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the round-3 contract review of PR objectui#10255 (card objectui#7190, record `5817576407`). ⛔ Not graded and not routed.

## Fact

Since objectui#7190 (PR objectui#10255), entering inline edit on the record page runs the widgets' cascade-clear effects:
- a **multi select / checkboxes** field prunes to a real array (`onChange(stillOffered)`);
- a **single select / radio** prunes with `onChange(undefined)`.

On Save:
- `InlineEditSaveBar.handleSave` passes `inline.draft` unchanged to `dataSource.update`.
- `@object-ui/data-objectstack`'s `update` hands `data` to `@objectstack/client` `data.update`, which sends `PATCH` with `body: JSON.stringify(data)`.
- `JSON.stringify({ tier: undefined })` is `{}`.

⇒ The scalar prune is **never written**. The user sees the field emptied and presses Save, the stored value survives, and it reappears after refresh. The array prune IS written. ⇒ the two prunes disagree, and the scalar one is a silent UI/server divergence.

## Reach

The same widget effects run in forms (ADR-0058 parity). Whether a form submit path hits the same `undefined`-drop is NOT MEASURED.

## ⛔ Not claimed

⛔ No fix is chosen. Options include widgets emitting `null` for a cleared scalar, the save path mapping an own `undefined` to `null`, or the transport preserving it. Each reaches a different surface.

## Dedupe words

`cascade prune undefined JSON drop` · `select radio cleared not saved` · `onChange undefined PATCH omitted` · `inline edit prune reappears after refresh`
